description: Defines the class QuicSpdyClientSessionBase and related types for managing HTTP/3 client sessions with server push promises in the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
classes.description: Base class for client-specific QUIC SPDY sessions, handling server push promises and session management.

methods.name: HandlePromised
methods.description: Handles incoming PUSH_PROMISE frames, validates, and creates promise info.

methods.name: IsAuthorized
methods.description: Verifies if the server is authorized for cross-origin push based on hostname.

methods.name: GetPromisedById
methods.description: Retrieves promised info by stream ID.

methods.name: GetPromisedStream
methods.description: Returns the promised stream associated with a stream ID.

methods.name: ErasePromisedByUrl
methods.description: Removes promised info from internal maps by URL.

methods.name: DeletePromised
methods.description: Deletes promised info and cleans up.

methods.name: ResetPromised
methods.description: Resets a promised stream with an error code.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a stream is closed.

methods.name: ShouldReleaseHeadersStreamSequencerBuffer
methods.description: Determines if headers stream buffer should be released.

methods.name: ShouldKeepConnectionAlive
methods.description: Indicates if the connection should be kept alive.

methods.name: OnPromiseHeaderList
methods.description: Processes headers of a push promise.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Processes response headers to detect server push streams.
